corrected_construction.ported_initial_newline_mapping: Replace every CRLF pair with LF, then every remaining CR with LF; no other character changes at this stage.
corrected_construction.interval_transport_definition: Intervals before an edit stay fixed; intervals after it shift by replacement length minus removed length; intersecting intervals become the smallest interval containing retained interval parts and the replacement. Later-operation IDs are recorded for every intersection.

port_interval_validation.other_statuses: Not-applicable and explicitly covered records retain the supplied port audit decisions; no terminal interval is invented for them.

privacy.policy: Only the three explicit substitutions in the shared script; no other input rewriting before comparison.

alignment.policy: Bound every hunk with neighbouring validated anchors; label ranges or last-anchor extent. Never infer an interpolated exact folio.

raw_body_slice.start_basis: first verified Exposé I anchor in EN_ALIGNMENT.json
raw_body_slice.end_basis: start of final end-document token; no trimming

operations: At every recorded corrected character position insert percent + newline, the exact scan/folio marker, and newline.
Select the document body and then the first retained folio-1 marker through the body end.
Retain exact marker lines; for each other unescaped percent, remove the percent and the rest of its physical line including the ending.
Concatenate the retained characters without trimming or other rewriting.
representation.qualification: This proves the exact source-to-body mapping. Page ranges in the change table use validated anchor bounds, and no additional visual equivalence is claimed.

patch_verification.method: GNU patch applied to an isolated copy
